outcome: effective dose of norepinephrine for preventing hypotension during cesarean delivery
cohort: 42 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: The effective dose 50 (ED50) of a bolus of norepinephrine for preventing hypotension in elective cesarean delivery is 0.067 µg/kg (95% CI, 0.056-0.081), with an ED95 of 0.121 µg/kg (95% CI, 0.1-0.207).
